messages:
maya: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/rwinf/pull/20499 needs cross-team eyes. It's a canary + rollback config for model routing. Requesting runtime, platform, infra, security reviews before merge window tomorrow 10:00 PT.

sam: pinging @maria @liam @nina for quick eyes. Can we get owners for canary plan + fallback policy?

maria: I can take runtime perf. Can you paste the perf numbers for p50/p95? Also what's kv cache change?

maya: kv cache tweak is minor — prefix cache TTL adjust (50ms median cache hit now). Microbench runs: `make bench-seq && ./bench --model=guanaco-7b --seq=512` => p50 38ms, p95 120ms (on dedicated sim). I'll paste logs.

maria: ok that's within expected range. two notes: 1) ensure KV restore path guarded (added feature flag), 2) add canary weight ramp step to 10% for 30m then 50%.

liam: infra: need to confirm network egress & ephemeral storage for canary autoscaler. Any new mount or service account? If not, I can sign off.

maya: no new mounts or SAs. using existing autoscaler, no HPA changes. estimate +0.8 GPU-hours/hour at peak.

liam: cool. I'll check cost impact quick. If zero SA changes, infra OK pending cost ack.

nina: security: KMS rotation in this PR? The KMS policy diff shows a key alias change.

maya: it's an alias swap to point to staging key, not rotation. no secret material moved. But we can gate alias switch to canary commit.

nina: I can approve with a small note: add an audit log event on alias swap and a rollback plan (one-liner). otherwise :+1:

oliver: I can do platform rollout config review after standup (~11:15). If maria and nina agree on canary steps, we can schedule merge window at 10:00 PT tomorrow.

merge-bot: CI passed on branch (all checks green) — `e2e`, `bench`, `integration`.

maya: thanks all. action items: maria to add ramp steps in the rollout config, nina to add audit note, liam to confirm cost before EOD, oliver to post canary schedule. Will ping again once PR updated :rocket:

maria: will send PR update in 20m.

liam: cost check complete — incremental is acceptable. :thumbsup:

nina: audit note added. approving now.

oliver: posting canary schedule in #eng-platform — 10:00 PT start, 30m -> 10% -> 50% in 2h -> monitor. tagging owners.

maya: merging tomorrow after merge window if all still green. Thanks everyone :pray:
